subject: Human direction: simple coaching UI and streaming voice fix
body: Human clarified: guide students rather than grade them, and ask only what they are doing and what help they need. Main application 90eddf8 has two inputs, a brief focused answer and at most one scientific follow-up with optional reply. Removed completeness checklists/scientific severity badges; retained safety escalation, emergency copy and source validation. C001 wire shape unchanged; policy version .4. Browser WebM/Opus duration is derived from bounded packet timing; synthetic streaming upload now succeeds live (200,664ms) where it previously failed422.
